Located in the heart of Austin, Barton Springs Pool is one of the most iconic spots to cool off at during the summer. Barton Springs Pool has been one of the most popular summer gathering spots for Austinites for more than 90 years. It spans a massive 3 acres in size and is located within Zilker Park, right in the heart of the city. The water is so refreshing and there’s plenty of green space surrounding to relax and soak in the sun! The scene at Barton Springs during a busy summer day looks like something out of a movie!
